note: Weight classes of the CHIMport order (tools/chim_weight_table.py). Thresholds are data: the maintainer sets them here, never in code. Headroom = the least free bytes of the cell's frame ring under the CHIM heap budget (chim-heap.json headroom_bytes); 1 MB = 1,000,000 bytes. Placed faces = faces drawn from the cell's placed models (stats.faces.chim_placed). A class with max_placed_faces 'median_shipped' takes the median of the cells already on CHIM. The first class a cell meets is its class; a cell failing an audit, over the budget or not converted gets the fallback classes below.

over.label: Over the limit or failing an audit

unmeasured.label: Not measured (not converted, or no headroom figure)

seabed.label: Seabed cell (LAND record under water), to be converted as its own cell
